title: Robust map-filter anchor improved listing-view conversion

change.control: Bookability Filter alpha 1.0 uses the highest-bookability listing as its anchor.
change.variant: Use the second-highest listing, equivalent to the median of the top three, as anchor.

quote: Searchers to listing viewers conversion improves by 0.15 %
notes: Number of displayed pins rose 6%. This robustness experiment differs from first introducing the Bookability Filter; bound p<10^-4 retained qualitatively rather than stored as exact.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
